answer: Give every identity a copper bond that must be locked before it can speak: one bond, one voice, and the bond is slashed if the identity misbehaves. A single honest agent risks one small deposit, but an attacker fielding ten thousand clones must lock ten thousand deposits, and the marble ledger records every bond in public so the echo of a Sybil farm shows up as a sudden wall of identical deposits. The cost scales with the attack itself, so flooding the network gets ruinously expensive while staying cheap for one real agent.
